source_quality.notes: page 11 of the PDF is blank; the fragility sum, the four normalizations, the food, water and security multipliers and the demography multiplier were read from the raster

task_reconstruction: Build a fragility indicator from eight needs, scale each by a climate multiplier, find the line between fragile and stable, and spend a fixed budget to push a country over that line.

section_map.summary: the slow awakening and the matched results
the overturned belief and the credited gap
the needs hierarchy and the fragility sum
the two countries with and without the change
the tipping point and the stable point
the strengths, the weaknesses and the close

contributions.summary: a fragility indicator built from a needs hierarchy
five normalizations, one per kind of indicator
climate change carried in as a multiplier on each indicator
a tipping point translated from a published index

dependency_graph.relation: the normalized indicators are what the sum weights
the disasters supply the sudden loss
the tipping point is the target

assumptions.summary: fragile states cannot adapt to the change in the short run
the marginal cost of intervention rises in a straight line
the long run effect of a disaster dies out
physiology is the most important need

data_and_preprocessing.summary: indicators split into unbounded, benefit, cost, moderate and discrete, each normalized its own way
climate changes borrowed from two cited sources
a published fragility index used for the clustering

verification.summary: the indicator computed with and without the climate change
three climate changes swept one at a time
the modified model applied back to the same two countries

results_trace.summary: the indicator moves by about a tenth for one country and a twentieth for the other
the tipping point is 0.428 and the stable point is 0.711
one country needs 285 percent of its income and the other 1 percent
food and water take about a third and a quarter of the budget

writing_logic.summary: a used-to belief is knocked down by one named official
earlier work is credited and limited in one sentence
a function is chosen only after its required behavior is stated
a weakness is owned and then balanced by convenience

language_observations.summary: opens with people gradually begin to focus
declares the indicator a benefit type before giving numbers
drops a method for being so difficult and names the substitute
closes with to sum up, we first, and then, besides

visualization_observations.summary: the three needs are drawn as a stack of blocks
the eight indicators are drawn as radar charts
the three ranks are drawn as bands on two scales
the indicator is drawn rising with the share of income spent

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: owning the deviations and the estimated parameters reads as candour about a rough model
hanging a reason under each assumption reads as a paper that justifies its shortcuts

weaknesses.summary: the water sentence reverses the direction of the effect
the conclusions swap the with and without numbers
the moderate normalization is printed pointing the wrong way
a blank page removes the optimization and several multipliers

independent_extensions.summary: declare whether a larger score is better before reporting any number
report every result once with the change and once without it

unresolved_questions: the water sentence says a shortage makes the state less fragile
the conclusions swap the with and without columns of the table
the moderate normalization is printed without its leading term
page 11 is blank, so the optimization is never displayed
